not_a_medical_device: Not a medical device. This is a portfolio demonstration on synthetic data. It does not diagnose, prescribe or provide medical advice, is not clinically validated, and makes no regulatory or compliance claim (including HIPAA).

pipeline_stages.description: Validates the submission and consent, detects PHI patterns, assigns ids.
Extracts symptoms, duration, onset, severity and red flags. Mock mode: deterministic rule-based baseline (#40), not LLM output.
Generates the patient report; the rule-based guard blocks diagnosis/prescription content, masks PHI patterns and adds emergency guidance.
Deterministic #29 rules set needs_review with reason codes.
Stores the record for the clinic; escalated intakes trigger a signed, PHI-free webhook (#33).
Clinic staff review the queue, evidence and timeline (#41) and can export FHIR R4 (#42).

safety_rules.description: Blocks a generated report containing diagnostic certainty.
Blocks a generated report containing prescription or dosing content.
Adds emergency guidance when emergency or crisis language is detected.
Masks PHI patterns (email, phone, IDs, dates, SSN, contextual names) in report text.

escalation_rules.rule: Emergency or crisis language in the intake or the generated report
Generated report blocked: prescription or dosing

extraction.limitation: In-sample: the rule-based lexicon was written with these 6 synthetic cases in view, so 1.00 is agreement with a tiny set, not a measure of real-world extraction quality.

safety_escalation.limitation: Match rates measure agreement with the labelled current rule baseline on 16 synthetic cases, not safety accuracy or recall. Known gaps are recorded, not fixed.

known_limitations: Safety guard and escalation are keyword/regex rules; paraphrases can be missed (known gaps in #32).
Mock-mode extraction is a small fixed lexicon; anything outside it is missed and lowers confidence.
Evaluation sets are tiny and synthetic; results are not clinical accuracy.
Retrieval (RAG) is not wired into the API; mock embeddings carry no meaning.
Raw intake text is stored unmasked and returned to authorized staff (timeline, FHIR export).
No HIPAA compliance, encryption at the application level, or rate limiting.
